3: O Lord my God, I cried to you, and you did heal me.
4: O Lord, you have brought up my soul from Hades, you have delivered me from [among] them that go down to the pit.
5: Sing to the Lord, you his saints, and give thanks for the remembrance of his holiness.
6: For anger is in his wrath, but life in his favor: weeping shall wait for the evening, but joy shall be in the morning.
7: And I said in my prosperity, I shall never be moved.
8: O Lord, in your good pleasure you did add strength to my beauty: but you did turn away your face, and I was troubled.
9: To you, O Lord, will I cry; and to my God will I make supplication.
10: What profit is there in my blood, when I go down to destruction? Shall the dust give praise to you? or shall it declare your truth?
11: The Lord heard, and had compassion upon me; the Lord is become my helper.
12: You have turned my mourning into joy for me: you have torn off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;
13: that my glory may sing praise to you, and I may not be pierced [with sorrow]. O Lord my God, I will give thanks to you for ever.
